name: Oasiscatalog Importer
author: oasisvisheratinnikolay

sections.description:
Oasiscatalog – Product Importer

A professional solution for integrating your WordPress store with the OasisCatalog wholesale catalog. The plugin automatically imports products, prices, inventory, and descriptions, saving you time on manually populating your website.

Main functions:

🔄 Automatic Sync
– Regular product and inventory updates
– Automatic product creation in WooCommerce
– Price and promotion syncing

🎯 Flexible settings
– Select specific sections and categories in OasisCatalog
– Set up filters by manufacturer, price, and availability
– Flexible markup system (fixed, percentage)
– Convert features to WooCommerce attributes

⚡ Performance Optimization
– Background data loading
– Import process logging
– Processing large product volumes
– Support for variable products

Requirements:
– Active WordPress with WooCommerce
– API key and UserID from your OasisCatalog account (www.oasiscatalog.com/cabinet/integrations)

Quick Start:
1. Install and activate the plugin
2. Obtain an API key in your OasisCatalog account
3. Configure import rules in the WordPress admin panel
4. Run synchronization

Automate your business with Oasiscatalog!

External services

This plugin connects to the API to retrieve data from the Oasis catalog. Product attributes, descriptions, brands, and logo application methods are included.

The plugin can also transfer information about orders from your website that include Oasiscatalog products to your Oasiscatalog personal account.

To connect to the API, you need a key from your personal account https://www.oasiscatalog.com/cabinet/integrations

External Libraries

The plugin includes/uses:

JavaScript:
1. Bootstrap
– Version: 5.5.5
– Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.3/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js
– Location: /assets/js/bootstrap.min.js
– License: MIT
– Purpose: Data visualization
– Loaded on: Plugin settings page

  1. Oasis-catalog/branding-widget
    • Version: 5.5.5
    • Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@oasis-catalog/branding-widget
    • Location: /assets/js/branding-widget.js
    • License: ISC
    • Purpose: Data visualization
    • Loaded on: product card

CSS:
1. Bootstrap
– Version: 5.5.5
– Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.3/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css
– Location: /assets/css/bootstrap.min.css
– License: MIT
– Purpose: Data visualization
– Loaded on: Plugin settings page

  1. Oasis-catalog/branding-widget
    • Version: 5.5.5
    • Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@oasis-catalog/branding-widget
    • Location: /assets/css/branding-widget.css
    • License: ISC
    • Purpose: Data visualization
    • Loaded on: product card
sections.installation: The plugin is launched via the task scheduler. Please see the plugin settings for more information.
sections.faq:
Where can I report bugs?

Report bugs on the GitHub repository https://github.com/oasis-catalog/wp-oasis-importer/issues
